decisions.topic: Type 1 behavior when the whole-BBox matrix snap exceeds the cap
decisions.decision: Do not treat snap refusal as permission to leave nonintegral device-pixel spacing. The source SHALL remains in force. Consider a bounded XStep/YStep adjustment or another in-bound method; if no method can meet both requirements, report an explicit interpretation limit rather than saying the source does not ask for consistency.
decisions.source: Table 74 Type 1, primary physical p.236/printed221; continuation and step definition, p.237/printed222. It says the processor MAY adjust XStep, YStep, and matrix; SHALL consistently space by a device-pixel multiple; SHALL NOT exceed 1 device pixel distortion. No exception for a wide BBox appears.
decisions.caveat: The PDF does not precisely define the distortion metric over an entire lattice. XStep-only adjustment changes each local interval by 0.4 px, while cumulative displacement from the originally desired lattice grows with site index. The test's intended finite region/cell and measured offsets should be reviewed by the parent before promoting this as definitive runtime nonconformance.

decisions.topic: ADR 1080's statement that a cell whose snap exceeds one pixel is not asked to be consistently spaced
decisions.decision: Potentially unsupported by the normative text. ADR1080's algorithm measures full transformed BBox-corner movement; when >1 it returns None, and caller preserves original step. This is a discretionary algorithm restriction but turns the Type1 SHALL into the Type2 treatment. The source's MAY lists changing XStep/YStep as available controls and does not state that a particular whole-cell matrix adjustment is the only permitted solution.
decisions.evidence: Current code: pdf-render/src/lattice.rs::snap_lattice and pdf-model/src/content/pattern/lattice.rs::Interpreter::lattice. Existing unit test explicitly records no snap for wide BBox; public tests only test in-bound small cell. ADR1765 checks read/implementation but does not adjudicate fallback. ADR1031 is historical and was superseded for viewer-stated magnification by ADR1080.
decisions.classification: Policy/conformance interpretation concern; the public regression draft is not run. No failure ID assigned.
